# Royal Museums Greenwich

> > Royal Museums Greenwich comprises four world-class heritage sites: the National Maritime Museum, Royal Observatory Greenwich, Queen's House, and Cutty Sark, housing the world's largest maritime collections.

RMG preserves and presents Britain's maritime, astronomical, and artistic heritage through collections spanning Ancient Egypt to contemporary art, including 100,000 sea charts, 3,500 ship models, and works by Kehinde Wiley. The museums offer research resources, educational programmes, and public engagement across naval history, astronomy, and conservation.

## Collections and Galleries

- [Our collection: The world's largest ship model collection](https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/our-collection-worlds-largest-ship-model-collection): World's largest ship model collection: 3500 items from Ancient Egypt onwards
- [Our collections: sea charts and maps](https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/our-collections-sea-charts-maps): Collection of 100,000 historical sea charts from Mercator to Captain Cook
- [Sea Things gallery at the National Maritime Museum](https://www.rmg.co.uk/national-maritime-museum/attractions/sea-things-gallery): Interactive gallery with 600+ maritime objects from Egyptian boats to Titanic
- [Ship of Fools by Kehinde Wiley](https://www.rmg.co.uk/queens-house/attractions/ship-fools-kehinde-wiley): Kehinde Wiley's Ship of Fools contemporary artwork at Queen's House
- [Christopher Wren's Octagon Room](https://www.rmg.co.uk/royal-observatory/attractions/christopher-wrens-octagon-room): Christopher Wren's 1676 Octagon Room, oldest part of Royal Observatory

## Research Guides and Resources

- [Research guide E1: World War Two: Papers in the National Maritime Museum](https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/research-guides/research-guide-e1-world-war-two-papers-national-maritime-museum): Guide to WWII personal papers and naval documents at National Maritime Museum
- [Research guide C2: The Merchant Navy: Tracing people: Master-mariners, mates and engineers](https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/research-guides/research-guide-c2-merchant-navy-tracing-people-master-mariners-mates): Guide to tracing Merchant Navy masters, mates and engineers from 1845 onwards
- [How to photograph the Moon](https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/space-astronomy/how-photograph-moon): Step-by-step astrophotography guide for photographing the Moon with telescope

## Maritime History Stories

- [Revealing an icon: conserving the 'Armada portrait'](https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/art-culture/conservation/revealing-icon-conserving-armada-portrait): Conservation story of Elizabeth I's Armada Portrait restoration and research
- [Jane Franklin: a remarkable woman](https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/maritime-history/jane-franklin-remarkable-woman-0): Jane Franklin's Arctic expertise and Franklin expedition search efforts
- [Black History Month: Marcus Bailey and the Battle of Jutland](https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/maritime-history/curatorial/black-history-month-marcus-bailey-battle-jutland): Marcus Bailey's service on HMS Chester at Battle of Jutland, WWI
- [Jonathan Hulls and the first patent for steam propulsion](https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/maritime-history/library-archive/jonathan-hulls-first-patent-steam-propulsion): Jonathan Hulls' pioneering 18th-century steam propulsion patent and experiments
- [The unfortunate Captain Death of the Terrible privateer](https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/maritime-history/library-archive/unfortunate-captain-death-terrible-privateer): Captain William Death's final voyage on privateer Terrible, Seven Years War

## Education and Community Programmes

- [Young People](https://www.rmg.co.uk/schools-communities/young-people): Youth programmes, workshops and activities across RMG venues
- [LGBTQ+ Family Network](https://www.rmg.co.uk/whats-on/national-maritime-museum/lgbtq-family-network): Safe space for LGBTQ+ families with creative activities at National Maritime Museum
- [Introduction to Astrophysics](https://www.rmg.co.uk/whats-on/astronomy-courses/introduction-astrophysics): Six-week evening astrophysics course covering solar system to cosmology
